C032.reason: Locate the recollection in the supplied August 4 and September 10 letters; repetition is not corroboration.

C042.reason: Preserve the consent-process ethical scope and separate urgent exception.

C049.reason: Specify WCAG Level A/AA and current recipient-size dates without backdating.

C053.reason: Do not turn a reported threat to portal access into an established termination.

C063.reason: The original three-page notice has now been examined; underlying decisions remain unexamined.

C064.reason: Retain the express MyChart alternative to a signature without presuming acceptance of qualified assent.

C067.reason: Separate multiple standard channels, exclusive MyChart use, and actual restriction states.

C078.reason: Split the access clock from the amendment clock now separately tracked as C249.

C092.reason: Retain actual practitioner, service, injury and knowledge/suspicion predicates.

C139.reason: Keep the patient's receipt-based response request separate from the notice's letter-date condition.

scope: All 105 added and ten edited units have specific review rows. Untouched units retain prior ownership and await deeper clause review. Source wording is examined; underlying events and individual legal applicability are not adjudicated.
recovery_scope: All 34 detailed rows and all 256 cumulative prose units recovered into Huey. Original review findings retain their prior-pass limits; no institutional investigation is initiated.
counterevidence_policy: Preserve evidence favorable and unfavorable to every participant. Distinguish direct document content, patient recollection, staff accounts and repeated source families.

review_rows.source_locator: S25 p.1 date; S26 p.1 first two paragraphs.
review_rows.source_based_observation: The supplied object is dated July 26; the follow-up reports July 7 hand-delivery.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which exact version was delivered July 7?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Delivered copy, intake log, envelope, revision/export record and receipt.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Separate versions, later export, date-entry error or different documents remain possible.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Record custodian and provenance reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Identify the object already held without requiring a renewed narrative.
review_rows.closure_test: Every receipt claim has an object and evidence link or remains explicitly unresolved.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Document dates examined; identity and delivery unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: Displayed dates on p.1 of all three documents.
review_rows.source_based_observation: September 10 and September 17 follow the September 9 notice.
review_rows.question_for_review: What materials were available to the notice's authors before issuance?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Draft/version timestamps, earlier communications, nonprivileged routing and receipt records.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Earlier transmission of the same substance is possible but requires evidence.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Notice custodian and independent process reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Prepare an object-and-receipt chronology before deciding notice or knowledge.
review_rows.closure_test: Later clarification is not backdated; any earlier notice rests on identified evidence.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Document sequence examined; actual review history unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The earlier communication demand was broader than later qualified requests.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which request/version was decided and which narrower request remains available?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Original requests, receipt dates, itemized responses and accessible current consent clarification where needed.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A legitimate refusal of the broad request would not necessarily resolve the narrowed request.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical service and accommodation reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Evaluate the narrowed request without erasing the earlier statement.
review_rows.closure_test: Decisions are tied to their actual request; editorial discussion creates no new consent.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Request wording compared; implementation unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The notice recognizes disagreement and requires respectful conduct.
review_rows.question_for_review: What specific conduct beyond disagreement is alleged?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Full exchange, dates, firsthand staff/patient accounts and applicable conduct policy.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Legitimate conduct limits can coexist with protected disagreement; neither characterization settles the facts.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Patient Relations, access reviewer and appropriate safety function.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Separate a prospective conduct commitment from disputed historical characterizations.
review_rows.closure_test: The decision identifies the rule, facts, relevant disability analysis and review route.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Notice wording examined; conduct findings unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The notice rejects universal certified-mail and multiformat requirements.
review_rows.question_for_review: What bounded written methods will be evaluated separately?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Specific request, workload and clinical reasons, proposed alternatives and actual exchange results.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: The broad and narrowed requests are not interchangeable.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical and accommodation decision-makers.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Agree length, timing, written-question and follow-up boundaries.
review_rows.closure_test: An effective option is supplied or an item-specific supported limit identifies an alternative.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Refusal scope examined; narrowed-request decision unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 §3 first offered accommodation; S02 pp.4–6.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Reasonable symptom-related time is offered, but its amount and use are not specified.
review_rows.question_for_review: Will the time permit reception, formulation, pauses and qualification?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Appointment allocation, agreed plan, actual use and patient/team feedback.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: An offer is neither demonstrated effectiveness nor no accommodation.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating service with communication/access expertise.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Agree processing and pause arrangements before the visit.
review_rows.closure_test: Usable exchange and remaining limitations are documented.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Offer examined; delivery and effectiveness unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 §3 examination bullet; AMA 2.1.1 items 1–3 and urgent exception.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Advance explanation is offered.
review_rows.question_for_review: How will understanding, voluntary agreement and a slow stop signal be handled?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Proposed steps, communication method, consent record and any actual emergency basis.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Explanation alone does not prove consent; this plan does not decide historical consent facts.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating clinician and consent/access reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Agree explanation, pause and withdrawal signals.
review_rows.closure_test: The plan supports understood proposed steps and valid consent or the actual applicable exception.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Offer and ethical text examined; patient-specific implementation unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 §3 AVS bullet; S02 p.5.
review_rows.source_based_observation: A standard after-visit summary is offered.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which durable accessible route will deliver it?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Document availability, portal status, delivery and alternative channel options.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Existence of a summary is not proof of receipt or usability.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical service and health-information staff.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Deliver the ordinary summary through an effective agreed route.
review_rows.closure_test: Actual delivery and usability are confirmed or barriers identified.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Offer examined; delivery unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 telemedicine bullet; S02 p.5 in-person request.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Telemedicine remains available when appropriate.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which unresolved questions require an in-person examination?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Clinical assessment, patient access/orientation account, proposed examination and transport constraints.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Remote availability does not decide adequacy for this particular need.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating clinician and access coordinator.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Choose the clinically appropriate format without a remote default.
review_rows.closure_test: Selected format addresses the identified need, consent and accommodation.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Offer and preference examined; clinical format decision unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 last accommodation bullet; S02 pp.4–5 communication sequence.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Typed output is allowed while clinician input remains verbal; the patient reports a reception/consolidation difficulty.
review_rows.question_for_review: How will incoming consequential questions be made usable?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Specific limitations, written-question trial, processing/qualification time and alternatives.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A TTS device may help output without resolving reception; effectiveness requires individual assessment.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating service and qualified communication/access reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Use brief written consequential questions and sufficient processing time.
review_rows.closure_test: The complete question-response-clarification exchange is usable without inferring incapacity from latency.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Documents compared; individual effectiveness unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.2 agenda bullet; S02 pp.5–6 preparation.
review_rows.source_based_observation: A clinic-provided agenda is declined; a patient agenda at the visit is permitted.
review_rows.question_for_review: Can a bounded patient agenda reach the clinician before the visit?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Submission route, length/timing limits, clinician availability and preparation records.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: The notice does not explicitly decide every possible pre-visit arrangement.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Scheduling, clinical service and access coordinator.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Set a short agenda limit and submission window.
review_rows.closure_test: Material reaches the clinician for its agreed preparatory purpose, with limits explained.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Wording examined; pre-visit routing unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Complete quiet is not guaranteed.
review_rows.question_for_review: What feasible reductions in interruption or avoidable noise were considered?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Room/time options, constraints, patient needs and trial feedback.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No silence guarantee is different from no possible mitigation.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinic operations and access reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Choose practicable quieter conditions and explain unavoidable noise.
review_rows.closure_test: Options and their effects are documented rather than only a guarantee refused.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Refusal scope examined; mitigation unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.1 §2; S02 p.5 MyChart account.
review_rows.source_based_observation: The notice names multiple channels; a separate psychiatry restriction is reported as a threat.
review_rows.question_for_review: What actually happened to which portal functions and services?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Original psychiatry message, restriction/permission records, patient notice and available written routes.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Threatened, limited and terminated are distinct; MyChart-only use is not stated.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Cross-clinic operations, access/privacy staff and Patient Relations.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Confirm stable functions and a durable written alternative.
review_rows.closure_test: Actual access state and usable route are verified without inferring total shutoff.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Document wording compared; original psychiatry communication and live access unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.3 first paragraph and acknowledgment; S02 pp.1–2 and 9.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Agreement may be conveyed by signature or MyChart message.
review_rows.question_for_review: Will a precise conduct affirmation preserve factual disputes and unresolved accommodation questions?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Exact condition, authorized interpretation, proposed qualified response and actual acceptance/refusal.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Another transmission method does not establish acceptance of qualified assent or automatic waiver of factual disputes.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Notice decision-maker, Patient Relations and competent access/legal reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Separate receipt, conduct commitments, factual assent and accommodation decisions.
review_rows.closure_test: Accepted and contested matters are identified; signature-only shorthand is removed.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Agreement alternatives examined; institutional acceptance unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: S24 p.3 first paragraph; S02 p.9 response-period qualification.
review_rows.source_based_observation: The clinic period runs from letter date; the patient's response request runs from receipt.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which policy, actual deadline and interim decision govern the contemplated next action?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Issue/delivery records, policy/version, any actual extension/stay and continuity plan.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A complaint does not prove a stay; requested response periods are not statutory tolling.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Authorized clinic administrator and qualified deadline/continuity reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Clarify the condition and interim continuity before contemplated discharge.
review_rows.closure_test: Clocks and actual decisions remain distinct; no court deadline or receipt date is invented.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Documentary clocks examined; operative policy and decision unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The public policy names clinical service and/or Patient Relations responsibility.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which function has accepted each accommodation question?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Assignment, scope, receipt and nonprivileged decision record.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A published policy does not prove review of this request.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating service and Patient Relations.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Provide one coordinating contact and separate competent owners.
review_rows.closure_test: Actual acceptance and next step are verifiable without privileged deliberations.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Public policy examined; case routing unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The policy provides escalation beyond the immediate clinical unit.
review_rows.question_for_review: Was available escalation considered before refusal?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Operational constraints, resource assessment, escalation and alternatives.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Local inconvenience is not automatically institution-wide impossibility.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical operating unit and applicable resource authority.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Assess feasible resources before transferring administrative burden to the patient.
review_rows.closure_test: Resources considered and the effective alternative or supported limit are identified.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Public escalation policy examined; actual resource decision unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: OPHD is an alternative first formal complaint route.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which independent route can receive the access complaint?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Current intake instructions, actual acknowledgment if submitted and assigned scope.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: This packet files no complaint; institutional timing language does not waive outside deadlines.
review_rows.competent_review_function: OPHD or Patient Relations within actual authority.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Provide a direct usable written route.
review_rows.closure_test: The route and actual receipt are distinguished; no case number is invented.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Public route examined; no live submission performed.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The separate linked policy was inaccessible through the reviewed public route.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which operative provisions and version govern this patient decision?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Authorized copy/excerpt, effective date, supersession and applicability.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Login restriction proves neither concealment nor unseen policy contents.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Policy custodian and competent institutional reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Supply the relevant operative provisions accessibly.
review_rows.closure_test: Actual provisions/version are read; unknown text remains unknown until then.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Public link/access result examined; internal text unavailable.

review_rows.source_locator: Patient-rights complaint assurance/responsibilities; PRIDE Professionalism and Integrity.
review_rows.source_based_observation: The institution publishes both patient complaint/access assurances and conduct responsibilities.
review_rows.question_for_review: How were these commitments applied to each decision?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Applicable policy, conduct facts, complaint handling and decision provenance.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Public values do not by themselves prove a legal violation or retaliation.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Patient Relations and appropriate independent reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Provide reasons and evidence rather than generalized professionalism labels.
review_rows.closure_test: Patient rights and staff concerns are both addressed under actual authority.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Public commitments examined; case-specific application unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Necessary communication aids have effectiveness/delivery requirements; technical web dates are distinct.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which need, aid, recipient and covered activity are at issue?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Entity coverage, actual request, options, delivery/effectiveness assessment and operative versions.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Current text is not automatically 2019 law; web compliance dates do not decide encounter communication.
review_rows.competent_review_function: ADA/504 access function and treating service.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Agree an effective exchange while technical-interface questions are separately reviewed.
review_rows.closure_test: Specific aid and communication results are documented without general certification.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Regulatory text examined; coverage and implementation unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The communication-subpart limit specifies burden, authority, reasons and alternatives.
review_rows.question_for_review: Is this limit invoked and was its actual decision process followed?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Head/designee decision, resources considered, written reasons, alternatives and recipient coverage.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: This is not a rule that every clinical refusal requires a recipient-head decision.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Authorized recipient decision-maker with access/legal expertise.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Identify the actual basis and assess an alternative under the provision.
review_rows.closure_test: Applicable elements are addressed rather than only custom or burden asserted.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Regulatory structure examined; actual invocation/compliance unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Personal equipment and required encounter aids are different categories.
review_rows.question_for_review: What device or service is actually requested and for what use?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Purpose, existing patient-owned technology, encounter needs and alternatives.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No blanket personal-device purchase entitlement or blanket necessary-aid exemption is established.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Access reviewer and clinical service.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Support an effective encounter with feasible existing aids where appropriate.
review_rows.closure_test: The actual category and resulting duty or limit are explained.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Regulations compared; requested-item classification unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: A conduct concern is not itself an adjudicated ADA direct-threat determination.
review_rows.question_for_review: What risk, rule, evidence and mitigation support any exclusion?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Full exchange, firsthand accounts, relevant objective evidence, individualized assessment and policy.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Neither the patient's denial nor an adverse institutional characterization settles risk; ordinary conduct rules remain distinct.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Competent safety/access reviewer with appropriate clinical input.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Clarify the standard and feasible protective modifications.
review_rows.closure_test: A reasoned determination distinguishes expression, risk and the actual legal/policy basis.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Source standards examined; risk and conduct facts unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The clinic declines investigative roles; the patient requests clinical care and separate routing.
review_rows.question_for_review: Who handles clinical relevance and who receives nonclinical allegations?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Role scope, relevant history, clinical questions, reporting analysis if triggered and accepted handoffs.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Treatment is not criminal jurisdiction; internal routing does not replace an applicable mandatory external report.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Treating service and competent separate review functions.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Create two identifiable tracks without mandatory retelling.
review_rows.closure_test: Care and allegation-review status are separately confirmed.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Role wording compared; actual care/routing/reporting unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The hospital grievance rule specifies response content within its scope.
review_rows.question_for_review: Does this clinic and grievance fall under that hospital process?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Actual operator/entity relationship, relevant provider status, governing grievance policy and response.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Not every clinic is assumed covered; no universal seven-day statutory period is asserted.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Hospital grievance function and qualified applicability reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Identify the correct process and written-outcome requirements.
review_rows.closure_test: Coverage and governing policy are established before any violation conclusion.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Hospital rule examined; clinic applicability unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: AMA 10.7 advisory role and rejected recommendations.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Ethics consultation advises and does not act as a criminal court.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which ethical care question will be referred and how will recommendations be handled?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Committee scope, actual referral, recommendations and permissible reasoned response.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No outcome is guaranteed or protected deliberation demanded.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical ethics and responsible care decision-makers.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Frame the care, agency and continuity issue for timely advice.
review_rows.closure_test: Actual referral/response is distinguished from a promise or adjudication.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Ethical text examined; actual consultation unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Records adequacy and fraudulent intent are distinct questions.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which exact entry is inaccurate or inadequate and on what evidence?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Entry, source, author/date, clinical relevance and correction disposition; intent evidence only where relevant.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No automatic fraud inference or mechanical backdating of current retention language.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Records custodian and qualified professional reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Resolve a specific item before expanding unproved allegations.
review_rows.closure_test: Each item is corrected, sustained with reasons, linked to disagreement or left unresolved.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Distinct legal standards examined; particular entries unresolved.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Access and amendment have different response periods and extension provisions.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which request and actual receipt started which applicable clock?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Request content, record-set scope, receipt, extension notice and response.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: More-protective state law and exceptions require separate review; no filename establishes receipt.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Health Information Management and privacy function.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Classify and acknowledge the request correctly.
review_rows.closure_test: The correct process and actual response/extension evidence are identified.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Regulatory clocks examined; actual request handling unresolved.

review_rows.source_locator: Author-proposed safeguards; policy §12 and Patient Relations accessibility route.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Proposed handoff fields make responsibility observable; not every field is asserted as statutory.
review_rows.question_for_review: Who accepted the next concrete task?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Sending/receiving function, lawful information scope, acknowledgment, next step and fallback.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A copied message or referral does not establish completed care or investigation.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Clinical coordinator and each assigned review function.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Use one accessible entry point to coordinate distinct responsibilities.
review_rows.closure_test: Accepted and completed work are recorded separately with remaining gaps.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Proposed coordination structure; no actual assignment is asserted.

review_rows.source_locator: Author-proposed burden analysis; S02 p.6 upstream-burden account.
review_rows.source_based_observation: Propagation and savings remain hypotheses without identified evidence.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which decision produced which consequence and which feasible repair reduces the burden?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Dates, delays, patient/caregiver effort, staff work, costs, alternative causes and uncertainty.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No double counting, guaranteed savings, universal prevention or sole-cause attribution.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Patient-safety/quality reviewers with appropriate clinical/economic expertise.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Compare a small effective repair with repeated unresolved exchanges.
review_rows.closure_test: Each causal link or estimate is supported or explicitly unproven.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Proposed causal/burden analysis; no measured savings supplied.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The corridor is editorial metaphor, not quotation or historical proof.
review_rows.question_for_review: Does the image preserve a specific opportunity to answer rather than pronounce personal condemnation?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Editorial review of attribution and scope.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: No claim about Dante's exact wording, named-person damnation or legal elements.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Author and editorial reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: End the image with a concrete bounded responsibility.
review_rows.closure_test: The metaphor adds no unsupported factual or theological finding.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Authorial metaphor; not empirical evidence.

review_rows.source_based_observation: The recollection appears in earlier supplied patient letters.
review_rows.question_for_review: What was said in full context and what action followed?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Contemporaneous note/message, date, independent witness account, physician response and preceding question.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: Two patient letters repeating one recollection are one source family, not independent corroboration.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Independent factual reviewer.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Preserve competing recollections with attribution.
review_rows.closure_test: Exact versus approximate wording and contrary/supporting evidence are identified without presumed motive.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Attribution located; quotation and event not independently verified.

review_rows.source_based_observation: Reporting analysis requires practitioner, service, injury, knowledge/suspicion and correct-regime predicates.
review_rows.question_for_review: Which reporting regime applied at the relevant time and was a required report made?
review_rows.evidence_needed: Records, information received, role/employment, injury facts, report record and lawful disclosure limits.
review_rows.alternative_or_limitation: A suspicion-based duty need not await conviction; not every complaint meets all predicates. Check 11162.7 before stacking regimes; that section's official re-fetch was not completed in this pass.
review_rows.competent_review_function: Qualified California reporting/legal reviewer and actual mandated reporter.
review_rows.proposed_low_burden_step: Determine the applicable trigger and lawful report status promptly where required.
review_rows.closure_test: An element- and date-specific assessment identifies supporting, contrary and missing evidence; this packet sends no report.
review_rows.evidentiary_status: Primary reporting provision examined; actual trigger, interacting regime and compliance unresolved.
